resource: Reward principals (characters eligible for a creature death's XP) settled per death
allocation_impact: Checked first, before loot planning or any durability call: settle_creature_death_rewards rejects the whole composition up front unless exactly one reward principal was supplied.
consumers: apps/game-server/src/combat/death_reward.rs (check_reward_principal_count, called from settle_creature_death_rewards before planning or minting anything)
notes: D77/D78 decision §4.1 row 10: "1 per death (single-principal slice)". `COMBAT01-DEATH-WORKFLOWS-PER-SCOPE` (row 3) is deliberately not registered here: its own failure mode is recorded as structurally unreachable, bounded by the still-unregistered D57 creature-count envelope, and this composition keeps no scope-wide active-workflow counter to check; registering an unenforced ceiling would be a fake guard.
